title: Fresh thesis correctness review
summary: 534 pairs and 2,507 budgets passed a fresh reference; seven original Lean lemmas replayed. Raw-optimum Cover is false, and normalization needs active compatibility. Universal correctness remains open.

claims.label: Universal graph correctness
claims.detail: Requires graph normalization, original-edge transport, source coverage, contraction, termination and marked-state composition.

claims.label: Raw optimal-cutset coverage
claims.detail: Exact initial-state A2BC counterexample to universal Cover; source existence coverage remains possible. This is a proof-interface finding, not a failed decision.

claims.label: Normalization domain
claims.detail: Literal Lemma6.5 fails without active compatibility even when its LCA parent exists. Counterexample violates the intended active invariant; no algorithm counterexample follows.

claims.label: Fresh exact decisions
claims.detail: All 225 n4 pairs, 150 fresh n5 pairs, 150 fresh n6 pairs, and nine author examples; all nine branch variants reached.

lemmas.label: Seven original local lemmas
lemmas.detail: Clean Std-only Lean replay; axiom union propext and Quot.sound. True twin passes and false arithmetic twin is rejected for falsity.

lemmas.label: Existential branch interface
lemmas.detail: Three new local logical lemmas avoid universal raw-Cover; no axioms. AF coverage, exchange and transport remain hypotheses.
